symbols.name: numerator real part
symbols.meaning: The integer real part of the numerator a + bi of a Gaussian dyadic.
symbols.quote: Here $a$ and $b$ are the integer real and imaginary parts of the numerator $a + bi$, which is therefore a Gaussian integer.

symbols.name: numerator imaginary part
symbols.meaning: The integer imaginary part of the numerator a + bi of a Gaussian dyadic.
symbols.quote: Here $a$ and $b$ are the integer real and imaginary parts of the numerator $a + bi$, which is therefore a Gaussian integer.

symbols.name: denominator exponent
symbols.meaning: A non-negative integer; the denominator of a Gaussian dyadic is the power of two 2^k.
symbols.quote: The exponent $k$ is a non-negative integer that sets the denominator $2^k$.
